Name: Simple Town Chatter (Big Update) Again
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#FDE68A]Simple Town Chatter[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]PC 1.29 · Android 1.5[/size]
Bring Pelican Town to life between the big conversations.[/center]

[center][b]34 original villagers · 5,878 spoken entries · 12 complete languages[/b]
Greetings, everyday chatter, festival remarks, farmer replies and more — with adjustable frequency and customisable speech bubbles.[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791518332-1438129524.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#A6EFB7]PC 1.29 · Android 1.5 — Performance & Pet Calls[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][b]Performance caching, now adjustable[/b]
Both editions reuse bubble text layouts and prepared character dialogue pools. In GMCM, toggle [b]Performance caching[/b] or choose [b]64 / 128 / 256 / 512[/b] text-cache entries. The default is [b]On, 128[/b]; larger limits use more memory. Without GMCM, use [b]PerformanceCaching[/b] and [b]CacheEntries[/b] in config.json.[/center]
[center]Unrelated item, icon and portrait reloads no longer discard measured text. Font reloads and normal lifecycle resets still clear text caches. Approach greetings do less repeated work, and waiting public-chat bubbles no longer allocate a fresh queue array every update. Live friendship, weather, settings and recent-dialogue checks remain active.[/center]
[center][b]Call your pet and let your farmer say it[/b]
With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48970]Pet Follow[/url] installed separately, enable its chat-call option and STC’s [b]Player chat bubbles[/b] and [b]Farmer speech[/b]. Type your pet’s name in ordinary public chat. Pet Follow handles following/staying; STC displays your submitted words above the farmer. Commands, private messages and system notices stay excluded. Pet Follow’s own location, weather and time rules still apply.[/center]
[center]The existing spoken-call path was checked with the downloaded Pet Follow DLL. STC does not teleport, restore or take control of pets. The reported disappearing-pet issue remains unconfirmed.[/center]
[center][b]Bubble appearance and reading[/b]
Choose Classic, Rounded or Cloud bubbles. Optional smooth character-overlap fading retains 80% opacity while a character is covered. Existing speech finishes its normal reading time during tool use; unrelated new chatter waits. Independent NPC/farmer colours and background opacity remain adjustable.[/center]
[center][b]Choose one edition[/b]
[b]PC 1.29[/b] is the main download for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4+.
[b]Android 1.5[/b] is the separate optional edition for compatible Android SMAPI 4.3.2+. Install it [b]instead of[/b] the PC edition. Android API checks used game 1.6.15.3; physical phone and complete modpack testing remain unverified. Keep your existing config.json and data folder when updating.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#A6EFB7]Earlier dialogue additions — 1.21[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]624 new English lines:[/b] 408 villager remarks, 96 monster reactions and 120 world observations. Situational remarks are included in the 408; substituting a recipient’s name does not create a new unique line.[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791518369-237906578.png[/img][/center]
[center][b]New dialogue and farmer reactions[/b]
Examples of the new writing, rendered with the native game interface. These are isolated previews. Actual lines depend on the speaker, listener and trigger conditions.[/center]
[center][b]Public player chat:[/b] show public typed messages above the actual connected speaking farmer. The received message and native emoji stay unchanged. Commands, private messages and system notices are excluded. Waiting messages expire or clear on departure; STC does not resend chat or create history loops.[/center]
[center][b]Monster reactions:[/b] independently enable encounter and victory comments. Ten supported monster families have specific writing, with generic fallbacks. Victory remarks follow the actual kill owner, including native bomb ownership; raised slimes and reviving mummies are excluded. Combat, drops and XP remain unchanged.[/center]
[center][b]World observations:[/b] occasional comments about real weather, time, visible surroundings and recent activity. Six groups cover seasons/weather, time of day, farming/foraging, fishing/waterside moments, mining/discoveries and travel/surroundings. Comments do not invent successful catches, harvests or discoveries.[/center]
[center][b]Original villagers → modded listeners:[/b] greetings, everyday thoughts, situational remarks, anecdotes and playful observations. Eligible custom characters remain listeners unless separately supported writing provides replies. No guessed relationships or custom-character responses. Existing unpublished companion packs are unchanged.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#DCC5FF]Choose your bubble colours[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#DCC5FF][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791518379-1632111389.png[/img][/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Independent NPC and Farmer bubble settings[/b]
Always-visible independent NPC Bubble Colour and Farmer Bubble Colour thumbnail pickers, with a live preview and normal Save, Cancel and Reset behaviour. Mouse and controller selection are supported.[/center]
[center][b]Eight bubble palettes at 25% background opacity[/b]
Default (White), Cream, Mint, Sky, Lavender, Rose, Peach and Dark Slate. Both speaker colours start and reset to White. One background-opacity slider spans 25–100%, default 100%; text remains readable and normal fading is preserved.[/center]
[center]Colour follows the actual speaker. NPC speech uses NPC Colour; farmer replies, public typed chat, monster reactions and world observations use Farmer Colour. Appearance changes affect STC bubbles locally.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#A6EFB7]Small conversations, familiar personalities[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#A6EFB7][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791518395-2101968187.png[/img][/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b]Friendship-aware chatter[/b]
Writing responds to friendship bands and actual relationship state, with appropriate dating and spouse exchanges. Krobus remains a platonic roommate. Native names and dynamic placeholders are preserved.[/center]
[center][b]Pets and farm-animal exchanges[/b]
Named pets, your own horse and nearby farm animals can join short exchanges. Animal questions unlock with friendship, with warmer alternatives where appropriate; native species sounds and animal-mute settings remain respected.[/center]
[center][b]Morning exchanges[/b]
Optional morning exchanges with eligible awake spouses, roommates and pets. Morning conversations complete at most once per day and retain native scene and visibility safeguards.[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791518422-1409545899.png[/img][/center]
[center]Daily chatter, twelve supported festivals, birthday remarks and heart-aware writing stay included. Exchanges use up to four lines. Native dialogue and scripted scenes take priority; villagers keep their usual movement, schedules and gameplay.[/center]

[center]Choose your language in Stardew Valley. All twelve main locales cover [b]5,965 text entries[/b]: 5,875 spoken entries and 90 settings/help entries. Player-written chat stays in the language its author used.[/center]
[center]Translations were authored directly with GPT and independently reviewed with AI for character voice, speaker roles, names, neutral address and exact placeholders. Fluent-player feedback is welcome; further editorial improvements are planned.[/center]
[center][spoiler]The 5,875 spoken entries contain 5,682 distinct exact English strings; 193 additional entries repeat existing wording across 111 groups. The original shared fallback pool of 64 and the new 16 generic monster fallbacks are already included. Translated copies, name substitutions and unpublished companions are excluded from the main English count.[/spoiler]
[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#A6EFB7]Installation & compatibility[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791518465-1675795553.png[/img][/center]
[center][url=https://smapi.io/]Get SMAPI[/url] · [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/center]
[center]No other Simple mod is required. Optional compatibility with Muttering Farmer can pause automatic STC farmer remarks while leaving NPC chatter available; public typed chat follows Farmer Speech. The optional Simple Dynamic Dialogues priority bridge lets native/decorative activity yield during STC reading.[/center]
[center]Eligible modded NPC listeners do not imply a complete dialogue pack for that expansion. Existing companion writing remains separate, unchanged and unpublished. Main-mod counts and twelve-language coverage refer to this download.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]Version 1.21 — combined update notes[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][spoiler]Version 1.21 — Combined changes from 1.12 to 1.21

Added 624 original English spoken lines: 408 original-villager remarks to eligible custom listeners, 96 monster encounter/victory reactions and 120 world observations.
Added public player chat bubbles over the actual speaking farmer, preserving received text and emoji while excluding commands, private messages and system notices.
Added separate monster encounter/victory settings and cooldowns with actual kill ownership, including native bomb ownership. Combat, drops and XP are unchanged.
Added world observations with their own switch and cooldown, based on actual surroundings and recent activity.
Expanded original-to-modded interactions beyond greetings; unsupported custom characters remain listeners. Existing unpublished companions are unchanged.
Added independent NPC/Farmer colour thumbnail pickers: White, Cream, Mint, Sky, Lavender, Rose, Peach and Dark Slate. Both default/reset to White.
Added one 25–100% background-opacity slider, readable text, preview, mouse/controller selection and staged Save/Cancel/Reset. Preserved normal fading and local-only appearance.
Completed Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian, joining English and Korean.
Translated the new dialogue and settings into all eleven translated languages. All twelve main locales now cover 5,965 entries: 5,875 spoken and 90 settings/help.
Reviewed character voices, linked speaker roles, native names, neutral player/listener address, platonic Krobus wording and exact dynamic tokens.
Corrected the legacy Brazilian Portuguese locale filename from pb.json to pt.json so native Portuguese language selection loads its translation correctly.
Checked native fonts, language lookup, wrapping and bubble bounds. Retained reading timing, visibility cancellation, native-scene priority, earlier writing and prior downloads.[/spoiler]
[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#A6EFB7]Feedback & credits[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]For problems, include your SMAPI log, STC version, game language, installed dialogue mods and the steps that triggered it. For translations, quote the line and describe the speaker and situation.[/center]
[center]Native renderer, localisation and isolated regression checks passed. Full live modpack sessions, multiplayer/split-screen and physical-controller play still need player testing. Interface images are isolated native-renderer examples, not live installed-save screenshots.[/center]
[center]Stardew Valley and its native artwork belong to ConcernedApe. Thanks to the SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu maintainers, and everyone sharing feedback.[/center]
